name: vellum
description: Warm and documentary: a parchment shell around a white document surface, a serif that carries every heading, hairline rules instead of shadows, and tables dense enough to read a hundred rows at once. Ink is the action; one deep teal is the signal.
tagline: Source Serif 4 · parchment shell · dense tables

forkedFrom.note: Forked for its compact controls and hairline rings, then given a warm ground, a serif heading axis, softer corners and a denser table rhythm.

source.note: Screens of a legal AI workspace shared by the owner, 2026-09-18. Design values only — the warm paper ground, the serif-over-sans pairing, the hairline rules, the table rhythm and the ink/teal split. No product's marks, wording or screen layouts are reproduced.
